delivery:
Delivery service and charges depend on the product, delivery address and access to your property. Your order confirmation identifies the service, final delivery charge and expected shipping window before payment.

Standard shipping delivers to the carrier's normal delivery point. Curbside freight delivers to an accessible curbside location and does not include indoor placement, unpacking, installation or assembly. Any additional service must be included in your approved quote.

Measure doorways, stairs and the intended installation space before ordering. Gazebos need a suitable foundation; saunas and fireplaces may need professional electrical or installation work.

Inspect packaging when your delivery arrives, note visible damage on the carrier receipt and keep photographs and packaging. Report damage promptly so we can arrange a resolution. If we cannot meet the agreed shipping date, we will provide an updated date and the option to accept the delay or cancel unshipped merchandise for a refund.
returns:
Request a return within 30 days of delivery using your order number and contact details. Products must be unused, uninstalled and complete, with the original packaging and accessories. Obtain return authorization before sending merchandise back.

Installed or assembled gazebos, installed saunas or fireplaces, and custom or made-to-order products are excluded from change-of-mind returns. These exclusions do not affect remedies for damage, defects, incorrect items or rights provided by applicable law.

For change-of-mind returns, the customer pays the actual return shipping charge. Original delivery or installation services already completed are not refundable. We do not add a restocking fee to an eligible return received in its original condition.

After an authorized return is received and inspected, eligible refunds are issued to the original payment method within 10 business days. Your payment provider may take additional time to post the credit. Unpaid order requests may be cancelled without a payment refund being needed.
privacy:
Home Retreat Direct uses the information you provide to manage accounts, review orders, arrange delivery, answer product questions and maintain customer reviews. This can include your name, email, telephone number, address, order history and content you submit.

Essential cookies maintain your sign-in session and shopping bag. Passwords are stored as hashes. The order submission form does not collect card numbers or bank credentials. Payment information is handled through the approved payment channel identified in your order instructions.

Hosting, email, image storage, delivery and payment service providers may process information needed to perform their services. Optional analytics or advertising tools operate only when configured. We do not sell customer account or order information.

Information is retained as needed to service orders, maintain account records, prevent fraud and meet legal obligations. Access is limited to authorized staff and relevant service providers. You may request access, correction or deletion of your information through the store's published contact channel, subject to records we must retain.

Product reviews are public after moderation; avoid including private contact or payment information. This store is intended for adults and does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
terms:
Home Retreat Direct offers products for the home, outdoor living and personal wellness. Prices are shown in US dollars. The price displayed for your selected model or finish includes any active product discount; delivery charges and applicable taxes are confirmed separately.

Submitting an order requests an availability and delivery review. No payment is collected at submission. The team confirms the exact items, final amount and delivery service before sending payment instructions. Payment should be made only through the approved channel in those instructions.

Special-order items are sourced for your approved order. Do not schedule installation until your delivery date is confirmed. Product dimensions, installation requirements and included components appear on each listing; decorative items in styled photographs are excluded unless expressly listed.

You may cancel an unpaid request. After payment, cancellation and return eligibility depend on whether sourcing, shipment or agreed custom work has started; the returns policy explains the standard conditions. Your statutory rights are unaffected.

Products must be installed, operated and maintained according to their instructions. Electrical, gas, structural or foundation work may require qualified professionals and local permits. Product photography may vary in appearance with lighting and screen settings.

If a product or pricing error affects an order request, we will explain the correction before payment and allow you to accept it or cancel. These terms apply alongside the delivery, returns, privacy and product warranty information available on this website.
warranty:
Warranty coverage is specific to the product and manufacturer. Where a manufacturer warranty is supplied, its terms determine the coverage period, exclusions, registration requirements and claim process. Product descriptions do not extend a manufacturer's warranty or imply authorization by a brand.

Keep your order receipt, model and serial information, installation records and photographs relevant to a claim. Follow assembly, installation, electrical and care instructions. Normal wear, misuse, unauthorized modifications and improper installation or maintenance may fall outside warranty coverage.

Contact the store with your order number and a description of the issue to begin a product support request. Warranty information does not replace applicable consumer rights or the store's responsibility for damaged or incorrect merchandise.
about:
Home Retreat Direct brings outdoor living, home comfort and personal wellness into one considered collection. From compact accent chairs to complete backyard retreats, we select pieces with useful features, clear product details and room for everyday life.

Our order process gives you the full picture before payment. Choose your products, submit an order for review, and receive confirmation of availability, delivery eligibility and the final amount.

Explore the galleries, compare specifications and find the pieces that feel right for your home.
faqs:
When do I pay?
No payment is collected when you submit an order. We first confirm availability, delivery eligibility and the final amount.

Can I order without an account?
Yes. Guest orders are supported. Keep your order number and confirmation link to follow progress.

What does Special Order mean?
The selected item is sourced for your approved order. Availability and a shipping window are confirmed before payment.

How do discounts work?
An active product discount is included in the displayed selling price and your shopping bag. Shipping and taxes are confirmed separately.

How does freight delivery work?
Curbside freight delivers to an accessible curbside location. Indoor placement or assembly is included only when stated in your approved delivery quote.

Can I compare products?
Select Compare on two to four products to view their specifications side by side.

Can I return a product?
Eligible unused, uninstalled products may be returned with authorization within 30 days of delivery. See the returns policy for exclusions and shipping information.
accessibility:
We aim to make product information easy to read and navigate. The store supports keyboard navigation, visible focus states, labeled forms and descriptive product image text.

If you encounter an accessibility barrier, use the contact form and describe the page and difficulty. We welcome feedback that helps make the store easier to use.
